messages:
maria: quick check-in on the rules editor UI — two items: visual density on mobile is cramped, and the validation toast says "Invalid order" which confuses PMs. Attached mobile screenshot.

sam: i agree on cramping. propose compact mode with 12px meta + single-line rule name, and a chevron to expand details. keeps reorder handle visible.

ishaan: Compact mode sounds good. For ordering, locking the left column for the priority number helps orientation during drag. also consider a subtle divider between groups so users can see logical buckets.

claire: validation copy ideas: "Rule conflict — unmet prerequisites" or "Ordering blocked — view dependencies". also add an inline "why" link that opens a focused popover listing affected rules.

accessibility-bot: a11y reminder: contrast needs to be >=4.5:1 for body text and aria-live polite for reorder announcements. ensure focus returns to moved item after keyboard reorder.

sam: animation proposal for preview simulation — animate placeholders and show a micro-timeline in the preview panel: 
```css
.preview-step { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); transition: all 160ms ease-out; }
.preview-step.active { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
```
this gives sense of before/after without full motion. include prefers-reduced-motion.

maria: nice. for fallback rules auto-inserted by the system, show a non-dismissable toast with link "Explain why" that opens the auto-fix modal. users have been surprised in usability tests.

ishaan: keyboard flow: when pressing Ctrl+Arrow to move, announce: "Moved 'Rate limit external API' to position 2 of 8". Provide an undo snackbar that persists for 6s.

claire: copy for toast: "Added fallback rule 'Default deny' because no route matched. \u2014 View change". micro-cta opens review diff in preview.

sam: perf note: long lists should virtualize rows but keep animation smooth by animating transform on the visible subset only. will prototype.

deploy-bot: Staging updated: https://staging.redwood.com/routing/editor/ux-compact-canary

maria: thanks! let's do a 15m sync tomorrow 10:00am — bring mobile screenshots, reduced-motion checks, and the two validation copy variants. goal: decide final microcopy and keyboard announcements.
